name: Uzziah
overview: Uzziah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Zechariah according to Nehemiah 11:4. Beyond this genealogical detail, there is limited additional information about his life or role in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Uzziah means 'YHWH is [my] strength,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning tied to the divine name of God. This proper name is recorded in Nehemiah 11:4 and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Uzziah was the son of Zechariah and, by inference, the father of Athaiah, as noted in Nehemiah 11:4. These relationships place him within a genealogical context in the tribe of Judah.
scriptureSignificance: Uzziah's significance in the biblical narrative rests primarily on his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah, as the son of Zechariah. This connection situates him within the post-exilic community documented in Nehemiah, contributing to the continuity of the people of God during that period.
